# Executive Assistant Persona

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — a gws persona: an operating mode for the agent as an executive assistant — start the day with a standup report (agenda + open tasks), prep each meeting (attendees, description, linked docs), triage the inbox prioritizing direct reports and leadership, schedule meetings with conflict checks first, and draft professional, concise replies. Loads four utility skills (gws-gmail, gws-calendar, gws-drive, gws-chat) and leans on the standup-report, meeting-prep, and weekly-digest workflows. Requires the gws CLI and a paid Google Workspace account — there is no free tier for this CLI. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: a persona is a behavior mode, not a new tool — calendar changes must be confirmed with the executive before committing, as the recipe itself insists; it drafts — it doesn't decide; gws-shared must be read first for auth and global flags. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
